description: This file implements image resizing operations using various filters (box, lanczos, hamming) within the skia graphics library, including filter computation, resizing logic, and integration with Skia bitmaps.

classes.name: ResizeFilter
classes.description: Encapsulates the computation and storage of convolution filters for image resizing, supporting different resize methods and filter support calculations.

methods.name: CeilInt
methods.description: Returns the ceiling of a float as an integer.

methods.name: FloorInt
methods.description: Returns the floor of a float as an integer.

methods.name: EvalBox
methods.description: Evaluates the box filter function at a given position.

methods.name: EvalLanczos
methods.description: Evaluates the Lanczos filter at a given position with specified filter size.

methods.name: EvalHamming
methods.description: Evaluates the Hamming filter at a given position with specified filter size.

methods.name: ResizeFilter::ResizeFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes filter coefficients based on resize method and source/destination sizes.

methods.name: ResizeFilter::ComputeFilters
methods.description: Computes convolution filter coefficients for a given dimension.

methods.name: ResizeFilter::GetFilterSupport
methods.description: Returns the filter support size based on resize method and scale.

methods.name: ResizeMethodToAlgorithmMethod
methods.description: Converts a general resize method to a specific algorithm method.

methods.name: ImageOperations::Resize
methods.description: Performs image resizing on a SkPixmap, returning a resized SkBitmap.

methods.name: ImageOperations::Resize (overload with SkBitmap)
methods.description: Performs image resizing on a SkBitmap, returning a resized SkBitmap.
